title: Hanuman Chalisa
opening_doha_meaning_1: Cleansing the mirror of my mind with the dust from Guru's lotus feet, I describe the pure glory of Lord Rama, which bestows the four fruits of life: Dharma, Artha, Kama, and Moksha.
opening_doha_meaning_2: Knowing myself to be devoid of intelligence, I remember the Son of the Wind, Hanuman. Grant me strength, wisdom, and knowledge, and remove my miseries and shortcomings.
verse_1_meaning: Victory to Hanuman, the ocean of wisdom and virtue! Victory to the Lord of the Monkeys, who illuminates the three worlds (Heaven, Earth, and Underworld) with his glory.
verse_2_meaning: You are the messenger of Rama, the abode of immeasurable strength. You are known as the son of Anjana and the Son of the Wind.
verse_12_2: Tum mam priye Bharat-hi sam bhai |
verse_15_2: Kavi kovid kahi sake kahan te |
verse_22_2: Tum rakshak kahu ko dar na |
verse_26_2: Man Karam Vachan dyan jo lavai |
verse_27_2: Tin ke kaj sakal Tum saja |
verse_31_1: Ashta sidhi nav nidhi ke dhata,
verse_35_2: Hanumanth se hi sarve sukh karehi |
verse_38_1: Jo sat bar path kare kohi,
setup_subtitle: Peace and wisdom in your pocket
feature_read_desc: A beautiful, distraction-free reading experience for the sacred verses.
feature_learn_desc: Deep dive into the profound meaning and significance of every stanza.
feature_free_desc: Completely free to use. Optional donations help support the platform.
learn_o1_m: Cleansing the mirror of my mind with the dust from Guru's lotus feet, I describe the pure glory of Lord Rama, which bestows the four fruits of life.
learn_o1_c: The Chalisa begins with a traditional invocation. Tulsidas speaks of cleaning the mind's mirror using the dust from his Guru's feet, emphasizing that spiritual insight requires a clear, humble heart.
learn_o2_m: Knowing myself to be devoid of intelligence, I remember the Son of the Wind, Hanuman. Grant me strength, wisdom, and knowledge, and remove my miseries.
learn_o2_c: This doha is a plea for empowerment. By acknowledging human limitations, the devotee creates space for divine grace through Hanuman, the life force (Prana).
learn_v1_m: Victory to Hanuman, the ocean of wisdom and virtue. Victory to the Lord of monkeys who illuminates all three worlds with his glory.
learn_v1_c: Establishes Hanuman as an ocean of wisdom. Tulsidas begins with "Jai" — an invocation of victory and blessings.
learn_v2_m: You are the messenger of Ram, the abode of incomparable strength. Son of Anjani and child of the Wind God — these are your sacred names.
learn_v2_c: "Pavan-sut" connects Hanuman to prana — the breath of life. He is a bridge between the human and the cosmic.
learn_v3_m: Great hero of immense valour, with a body hard as a thunderbolt — you dispel ignorance and dwell always with the wise and the pure of heart.
learn_v3_c: Focuses on Hanuman's role as a guardian of the mind. Devotion leads to clarity of thought.
learn_v4_m: Radiant with a golden complexion, adorned in splendid garments, wearing earrings that gleam, with flowing curly hair — your form is luminous.
learn_v4_c: A formal description used for meditation (swarup dhyan). Every physical detail is an invitation to focus the mind on the Divine.
learn_v5_m: In your hands shine a thunderbolt and a victory flag, while across your shoulder rests the sacred thread woven from munja grass.
learn_v5_c: Hanuman unites the traits of the warrior (flag/vajra) and the scholar (thread), showing that strength and wisdom are not separate.
learn_v6_m: You are the incarnation of Lord Shiva and the son of Kesari. Your immense radiance and power are worshipped by the whole world.
learn_v6_c: Acknowledges Hanuman's divine origin as the 11th Rudra (Shiva) and his status as a world-venerated hero.
learn_v7_m: You are the storehouse of knowledge, full of virtues and extremely clever. You are always eager to perform the work of Lord Rama.
learn_v7_c: Defines Hanuman's character: despite his infinite power, his only desire is humble service to his Lord.
learn_v8_m: You take great delight in listening to the stories of the Lord. Ram, Lakshman, and Sita dwell in your heart.
learn_v8_c: Highlights that even the most powerful being finds the greatest joy in simple devotion and listening to the Divine name.
learn_v9_m: You appeared before Mother Sita in a tiny form. You assumed a terrifying form to burn the city of Lanka.
learn_v9_c: Refers to Hanuman's mastery over physical form (Siddhis), allowing him to be subtle and fierce as required.
learn_v10_m: Assuming a gigantic form, you destroyed the demons and successfully completed the tasks assigned by Lord Rama.
learn_v10_c: Showcases Hanuman as the ultimate protector who clears all obstacles for the righteous and the Divine.
learn_v11_m: You brought the Sanjeevani herb and revived Lakshmana. Lord Rama embraced you with overwhelming joy.
learn_v11_c: One of Hanuman's most famous feats, demonstrating his resourcefulness and his irreplaceable importance to Rama.
learn_v12_m: Lord Rama praised you immensely and said, "You are as dear to me as my own brother Bharata."
learn_v12_c: The highest honor a devotee can receive—to be considered equal to the Lord's most beloved kin.
learn_v13_m: "May the thousand-mouthed serpent sing your glory," saying this, the Lord of Shri (Rama) embraced you once more.
learn_v13_c: Signifies that even a thousand mouths are insufficient to fully describe Hanuman's greatness.
learn_v14_m: Sage Sanaka and his brothers, Lord Brahma, and other great saints, along with Narada and Goddess Saraswati, sing your glory.
learn_v14_c: Hanuman is venerated by the highest cosmic beings and deities across the universe.
learn_v15_m: Even Yama, Kubera, and the guardians of the directions are unable to fully describe your glory. How then can poets find words for it?
learn_v15_c: Implies that Hanuman's virtues are beyond human (and even divine) comprehension and literary expression.
learn_v16_m: You did a great favor for Sugriva by introducing him to Rama and helping him regain his kingdom.
learn_v16_c: Highlights Hanuman as a mediator and a king-maker. He connects the seeker with the Divine.
learn_v17_m: Vibhishana accepted your counsel and became the Lord of Lanka, as is known throughout the world.
learn_v17_c: Shows Hanuman's influence on the righteous. Even in the enemy camp, his wisdom guided Vibhishana to safety.
learn_v18_m: You swallowed the Sun, which is thousands of miles away, thinking it was a sweet, ripe fruit.
learn_v18_c: Refers to Hanuman's childhood feat, showing his boundless appetite for the impossible and his raw cosmic power.
learn_v19_m: Placing the Lord's ring in your mouth, you leaped across the ocean; it was no surprise for you.
learn_v19_c: When one has the Lord's name or token, even crossing the vast ocean of existence becomes effortless.
learn_v20_m: All the difficult tasks in this world become easy by your grace.
learn_v20_c: A powerful assurance that no obstacle is too great when Hanuman's blessing is present.
learn_v21_m: You are the sentinel at Rama's door. No one can enter His presence without your permission and grace.
learn_v21_c: Symbolizes that Hanuman is the bridge to the Divine. One must first find favor with the devotee (Hanuman) to reach the Beloved (Rama).
learn_v22_m: All happiness comes to those who take refuge in you. With you as the protector, there is no reason to fear anything in the universe.
learn_v22_c: Assures the devotee that surrender to Hanuman grants complete protection, making one fearless against all worldly and spiritual obstacles.
learn_v23_m: Only you can contain your own immense radiance and power. All the three worlds tremble when you give a mighty roar.
learn_v23_c: Describes Hanuman's raw, unbridled energy. He is the master of his own cosmic force, which is so great that it awes the entire universe.
learn_v24_m: Ghosts and evil spirits do not venture near when the name of the 'Great Hero' (Mahaveer) is recited with devotion.
learn_v24_c: Establishes Hanuman's name as a powerful mantra for protection. His presence dispels negativity and dark influences instantly.
learn_v25_m: All diseases are cured and all pains are removed by the continuous chanting of the name of the brave Lord Hanuman.
learn_v25_c: Focuses on the healing aspect of Hanuman-bhakti. Faith and constant remembrance are presented as the ultimate remedy for physical and mental suffering.
learn_v26_m: Hanuman delivers from all troubles those who meditate on him with their mind, actions, and speech.
learn_v26_c: Emphasizes the power of sincere, total devotion. When one aligns their thoughts, words, and deeds in remembrance, Hanuman provides liberation from distress.
learn_v27_m: Though Rama is the supreme ascetic King over all, you are the one who accomplishes and manages all His tasks.
learn_v27_c: Highlights Hanuman as the 'Karta' (doer) who carries out the Divine will. It shows that the greatest power of Rama is manifested through Hanuman's service.
learn_v28_m: Whoever brings any other desire or longing to you obtains the limitless fruits of life.
learn_v28_c: Assures the devotee that Hanuman is not just for spiritual liberation but also for fulfilling the righteous desires of life, leading to ultimate satisfaction.
learn_v29_m: Your glory and splendor shine throughout the four ages and illuminate the entire world.
learn_v29_c: Proclaims Hanuman's immortality (Chiranjeevi status). His power is not limited by time or era; it is a constant presence in the universe.
learn_v30_m: You are the protector of saints and the destroyer of evil forces, the beloved darling of Lord Rama.
learn_v30_c: Defines Hanuman's role as the guardian of the righteous and the scourge of the wicked. His status as Rama's most beloved devotee is his ultimate identity.
learn_v31_m: You are the bestower of the eight supernatural powers and nine divine treasures; this boon was granted to you by Mother Sita.
learn_v31_c: Hanuman is the repository of all spiritual and material wealth. His authority to grant these to devotees is a direct gift from the Divine Mother.
learn_v32_m: You possess the elixir of Rama's name; may you always remain the humble servant of the Lord of the Raghus.
learn_v32_c: Devotion is presented as a spiritual medicine (Rasayan) that heals the soul. Hanuman is the keeper of this nectar, yet he remains the ultimate example of humility.
learn_v33_m: By singing your praises, one reaches Rama and is released from the sufferings and cycles of many lifetimes.
learn_v33_c: Reaffirms that the path to God is through his most beloved devotee. Chanting Hanuman’s name resolves the karmic debts of countless past lives.
learn_v34_m: At the moment of death, such a soul goes to the eternal abode of Rama, staying forever in the state of a Divine devotee.
learn_v34_c: Guarantees spiritual safety. It promises that the devotee’s soul will never fall back into ignorance, ensuring an eternal connection with the Divine.
learn_v35_m: One need not contemplate any other deity; by serving Hanuman alone, one attains every form of happiness and peace.
learn_v35_c: Reaffirms Hanuman's absolute sufficiency in this age (Kali Yuga). He is seen as the complete proxy for the Divine, capable of providing total fulfillment.
learn_v36_m: All difficulties cease and all pain vanishes for those who remember and meditate upon the mighty hero, Hanuman.
learn_v36_c: A powerful reassurance of Hanuman's role as the dispeller of obstacles. It emphasizes that constant remembrance is the key to mental and physical relief.
learn_v37_m: Victory, victory, victory to Lord Hanuman! Please bestow your grace upon me in the manner of a supreme Divine Teacher.
learn_v37_c: Tulsidas elevates Hanuman to the status of a Guru. It is a humble plea for guidance, acknowledging that spiritual progress requires the grace of a master.
learn_v38_m: Whoever recites this prayer a hundred times is released from all bondages and attains supreme bliss.
learn_v38_c: Mentions the specific fruit of dedicated practice. Bondage refers to both physical constraints and the spiritual cycle of birth and death (Samsara).
learn_v39_m: Whoever reads this Hanuman Chalisa attains spiritual perfection; Lord Shiva himself is the witness to this truth.
learn_v39_c: Provides a divine guarantee. Shiva, the ultimate yogi, validates that this hymn is a shortcut to spiritual accomplishment (Siddhi).
learn_v40_m: Tulsidas is forever the servant of the Lord. O Master, please make my heart your permanent abode.
learn_v40_c: The final prayer of the author. It shifts the focus from external feats to internal presence, asking the Divine to dwell within the heart forever.
learn_c1_m: O Son of the Wind, dispeller of misfortunes, the embodiment of auspiciousness — please dwell in my heart along with Lord Ram, Lakshman, and Mother Sita.
learn_c1_c: The final prayer asks Hanuman to stay eternally within the devotee's heart, bringing the entire Ram Durbar with him.
